{{Top|leg}}
A '''fossil-fuel generator''' was a type of [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]]. By most standards, a fossil-fuel generator was inefficient. Scarcity of fossil fuels and the resultant environmental damage meant the generators were not in common use. Fossil-fuel generators also required constant maintenance several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] a [[Standard week/Legends|week]]. The plants were also not used if they were meant to be concealed due to the waste smoke and heat being able to be seen both by the naked [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and on [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
